scope: Documentary lineage and aggregate interpretation only. No new contract, adapter, collector, attack execution, or admitted record.

native_endpoints.artifact: source_artifact record exact (id,revision), if an actual artifact is established
native_endpoints.model: model_version record exact (id,revision), with checkpoint certainty preserved
native_endpoints.evaluation: safety_evaluation record exact (id,revision), only if required fields can be supported

allowed_documentary_edge_types.reported_failure_followed_by_change: Chronology, not effectiveness. Separate observed/reported failure assertion from intervention assertion.
allowed_documentary_edge_types.change_has_final_outcome: Final effectiveness is unknown unless a matching final-configuration retest is identified. A null target with explicit reason is permitted in this ledger, never a dangling native ref.
allowed_documentary_edge_types.matched_retest_of: Require all specified correspondence evidence and dated evaluator record; intended safeguard change is allowed, accidental checkpoint/configuration mismatch is not.
allowed_documentary_edge_types.derivative_summary_of: Two artifacts may describe one result; preserve publisher and original evaluator role, source dates and scope. Explicit source/result correspondence needed.
allowed_documentary_edge_types.revision_of: Preserve old/new raw assertions; native supersedes only for consecutive revisions of the same persistent record. Correction scope and protocol equivalence remain separate.
allowed_documentary_edge_types.static_helper_related_to_result: Code concern may be related, but production mapping remains unresolved without primary provenance; never a proven published-error edge.
allowed_documentary_edge_types.benchmark_family_dependency: ME002 may depend on ASI001 without sharing its runtime or scoring semantics.

manual_join_rule.unknown_or_mismatch: Hold/reject comparative effectiveness; retain both individual observations with qualifications.
manual_join_rule.sufficient_result: Bounded comparability of stated observations only; no causal, population-wide or significance claim without separate evidence.

native_limits: No generalized remediation/retest/derivative edge in any of the three contracts.
evidence.relation is only supports, contradicts or context.
parent_model_refs describes model derivation, not safeguard changes.
source_artifact.translation describes translation, not developer summaries.
Structured sidecar fields cannot be inserted into native data objects with additionalProperties=false.

branch_instances.failure_rule: Prior exact-commit catalog documents error→security=0 static convention.
branch_instances.production_mapping_null_reason: No explicit primary mapping from helper to paper-v2 estimate/interval production.
branch_instances.runtime_null_reason: Dependency lower bound and benchmark family are not an immutable runtime.

branch_instances.null_reason: Final-configuration issue prevented verification; no matching dated public retest established by this contract review.
branch_instances.unrelated_comparison: Model B >420-minute biological-misuse observation is not the GPT-5.5 cyber retest.

branch_instances.null_reason: No release/checkpoint-specific original established; similar/later titles cannot establish correspondence.
